adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts`, calendar references were changed from a single `find(...)` to `filter(...)` and are now processed in a loop (`calendarReference = ...filter(...); for (const reference of calendarReference) { ... }`). However, in the `newBookingId` merge cleanup path immediately after, the code still does `const oldCalendarEvent = booking.references.find((reference) => reference.type.includes("_calendar"));` (single reference) to delete the old event. With multiple calendar references (now possible/expected after the refactor), only the first matching old calendar reference would be deleted, leaving the other old calendar events orphaned at the old time.
